title: Rabbi Shimon ben Akashya
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: His precious saying remains to us in the Mishnah at the end of Kinnim: “The elders of the unlearned — the older they grow, the more confused their minds become; but the elders of Torah are not so — rather, the older they grow, the more settled their minds become.”

notes.text: Mishnah Kinnim 3:6 gives the contrast and includes verses from Job. Hyman excerpts the saying.
